chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
The one who enters the grave, so he should not exit except from the side of the two legs.
ai.seo_question: What is the proper way to enter and exit a grave according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi prescribes entering the grave feet-first and exiting head-first, mirroring the orientation of the deceased to symbolize a respectful transition between the living and the dead. In Shia scholarly tradition, this practice is viewed as an act of adab (etiquette) that honors the barzakh (intermediate state) of the soul, reinforcing the continuity of life’s rituals even after burial.
